The work in front of us Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and grow into the rest. Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies, partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code Payments and billing ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging, observability and alerting, consent and retention The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access Third-party integrations — usually the seam between two systems that were never designed to meet Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. They are built around agent-assisted development rather than merely tolerant of it — the conventions, the tooling and the review gates all assume it. Agents do most of the implementation and much of the review; humans design, verify and approve. Remote first, with most of the team in Europe and everyone together in person at least twice a year.
